title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Smith College
description: Current, under-21-safe food and essentials destinations with official late-hour evidence in Northampton and nearby Hadley/Holyoke.

cards.title: Amanouz Café
cards.subtitle: 44 Main St, Northampton
cards.notes: Use the official hours before heading downtown; the café lists service through 10 p.m. most nights and 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Moroccan and Mediterranean option with posted late-evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Amanouz Café lists hours until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday at 44 Main Street.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 8 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 8 a.m.–11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Teapot
cards.subtitle: 116 Main St, Northampton
cards.notes: Check the day’s posted schedule, then use its Main Street location for takeout or delivery; vegetarian dishes are listed on the official site.
cards.short_summary: Chinese restaurant and delivery option with late posted closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Teapot lists hours until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday at 116 Main Street.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Thursday, 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Friday–Saturday, and 11:30 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Joe's Cafe
cards.subtitle: 33 Market St, Northampton
cards.notes: Plan for an earlier late-evening stop: the restaurant lists a 10 p.m. close, with its kitchen closing at 9:30 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Market Street pizza-and-spaghetti restaurant with a defined kitchen cutoff.
cards.evidence_claim: Joe's Cafe lists Monday–Saturday hours from 4–10 p.m., with the kitchen closing at 9:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Monday–Saturday 4–10 p.m.; kitchen closes at 9:30 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 241 King St, Northampton
cards.notes: Use the location’s ordering page to confirm availability before leaving; it identifies this Northampton store and supports carryout or delivery orders.
cards.short_summary: A King Street pizza location with an official store-specific order page.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official page identifies its Northampton store at 241 King Street Suite 115 and offers takeout or delivery ordering.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 241 King Street Suite 115
cards.access_notes: The official store page directs visitors to its current Hours section and states that location hours vary; verify the live close time before departing.

cards.title: Taco Bell on King Street
cards.subtitle: 203 King St, Northampton
cards.notes: This is the longest-hours option in Northampton proper. Confirm whether you want dine-in, drive-thru, delivery, or takeout before going.
cards.short_summary: A Northampton fast-food location whose official page publishes overnight hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 203 King Street Northampton location with drive-thru hours until 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 5 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru and dine-in hours until 3 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 5 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: Stop & Shop on King Street
cards.subtitle: 228 King St, Northampton
cards.notes: For groceries or prepared-food ingredients, use the store’s official listing and arrive before the posted close; Sunday has the earlier closing time.
cards.short_summary: A full grocery-store option open into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Stop & Shop lists its 228 King Street store open until 10 p.m. Monday–Saturday and until 9 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official listing gives store hours of 7 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 7 a.m.–9 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Taco Bell in Hadley
cards.subtitle: 348 Russell St, Hadley
cards.notes: If you are already traveling along Route 9, check the official location page for live availability and use its stated drive-thru hours.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Hadley location with published overnight drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 348 Russell Street Hadley location with drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell in Holyoke
cards.subtitle: 2199 Northampton St, Holyoke
cards.notes: Use this farther option only when you have a safe ride arranged; the official page separates late drive-thru access from earlier dine-in service.
cards.short_summary: A Holyoke location with a late drive-thru schedule published by the restaurant.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 2199 Northampton Street Holyoke location with drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Packard's Kitchen
cards.subtitle: 14 Masonic St, Northampton
cards.notes: Use the restaurant kitchen hours, not the later venue closing time, when planning a food order; its official page lists kitchen cutoffs by day.
cards.short_summary: A downtown kitchen with posted food service as late as 11 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Packard's lists kitchen service until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday at 14 Masonic Street.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists kitchen until 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday. Food access is not restricted to patrons 21+.

cards.title: Campus Pizza
cards.subtitle: 150 Fearing St, Amherst
cards.notes: For a late weekend order in Amherst, use the restaurant’s official schedule and confirm a safe round-trip plan before traveling from Smith.
cards.short_summary: An Amherst pizza counter with explicitly posted late weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Pizza lists Thursday–Saturday hours from 5 p.m.–2 a.m. at 150 Fearing Street in Amherst.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Thursday–Saturday 5 p.m.–2 a.m.; Wednesday 5–10 p.m.; Sunday 4–9 p.m.; closed Monday–Tuesday.

warnings: Late availability can change for holidays, special events, and operational needs; confirm the official source before leaving. Two farther options are included only for students with safe transportation.
